description: Evidence join scenarios (design §10.1-§10.2, frozen interface §14 item 11). Data-only in Milestone A (Task A3) — consumed by the real evidence recorder join in Milestone C (Task C3).

scenarios.name: capture-always-failure-is-failed-infrastructure
scenarios.description: Under evidenceCapture: 'always', a recorder capture failure is failed[infrastructure] — the finalize receipt MUST precede delivered.

scenarios.name: receipt-fields-present-in-delivery
scenarios.description: The finalize receipt {family, digest} + Execution ID enter the Delivery's evidenceRecords/executionIds.

scenarios.name: dispatch-context-artifact-in-captured-inputs
scenarios.description: The dispatch-context artifact written into input/ is registered in the recorder's captured input set, closing the anti-retro-claiming loop.

scenarios.name: seal-once-checkpoint-crash-reuse
scenarios.description: The Delivery is assembled once from the attempt record, checkpointed atomically, and reused verbatim on any recovery — never re-assembled.

scenarios.name: torn-checkpoint-re-read-variant
scenarios.description: A torn checkpoint (crash mid-write) is re-read, not re-assembled from a partial file — the atomic-publish discipline (temp+fsync+rename+dir-fsync) means a torn write never lands as the checkpoint at all.
